verdict.rationale: Datadog's own integrations catalog advertises 1,000+ vendor-maintained integrations, and the directory lists cloud services such as Alibaba Cloud and Amazon API Gateway plus an Agent Metrics integration, so cloud-service instrumentation through first-party integrations is documented. The pack never shows how hosts, containers, or Kubernetes clusters are instrumented by a vendor agent; the Kubernetes item is only an autoscaling page title. missing for 10: documented host agent installation/coverage, container instrumentation, Kubernetes cluster instrumentation (agent/DaemonSet or operator), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-based instrumentation.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations

citations.quote: Alibaba Cloud Altostra Amazon API Gateway
